name: Exp_BykovTrend_ColorX2MA
summary: This EA trades based on the BykovTrend indicator signals confirmed by a double moving average (ColorX2MA) trend filter. It opens buy positions when BykovTrend gives a bullish signal and the fast MA is above the slow MA, and sell positions under the opposite conditions. The EA includes configurable money management with fixed lot sizing and optional trailing stop functionality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BykovTrend指标信号并结合双均线(ColorX2MA)趋势过滤进行交易。当BykovTrend给出看涨信号且快线在慢线上方时开多单，反之为空单。EA包含可配置的资金管理功能，支持固定手数和可选的移动止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用BykovTrend指标作为主要入场信号发生器，结合ColorX2MA双均线系统进行趋势方向过滤，仅在与大趋势一致时才执行交易。入场条件为：BykovTrend出现箭头信号，且快线MA与慢线MA的相对位置确认趋势方向一致时开仓。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、反向信号平仓以及可选的移动止损跟踪。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，用户可直接设定交易手数，也可通过资金管理百分比动态计算。资金管理方面提供了账户余额百分比计算手数的功能，但没有内置加仓或减仓逻辑。整体策略逻辑清晰，双重过滤减少了假信号，但缺少对市场波动率和点差的适应性考虑。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses the BykovTrend indicator as the primary entry signal generator, confirmed by a ColorX2MA dual moving average system that acts as a trend direction filter, only executing trades when signals align with the broader trend. Entry conditions require a BykovTrend arrow signal combined with the fast MA being above or below the slow MA to confirm trend direction before opening a position. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, position closure on opposing signals, and an optional trailing stop mechanism for profit protection. Position sizing defaults to fixed lot mode where the user directly specifies trade volume, with an optional money management feature that calculates lot size based on a percentage of account balance. The strategy logic is clear and the dual filter reduces false signals, but it lacks adaptive considerations for market volatility and spread impact on execution quality.

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理自动计算手数

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for calculating lot size per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别订单

pros: 双重指标过滤减少假信号，BykovTrend信号加均线趋势确认提高了入场质量
参数设计灵活，支持多周期分析，可分别设置BykovTrend和ColorX2MA的时间周期
具备可选的资金管理功能，可根据账户余额自动计算手数，有助于风险控制
代码结构清晰，指标调用和信号逻辑分离，便于理解和修改
支持移动止损功能，可以在趋势行情中锁定浮盈
pros_en: Dual indicator filtering reduces false signals — BykovTrend plus MA trend confirmation improves entry quality
Flexible parameter design supports multi-timeframe analysis with separate timeframe settings for each indicator
Optional money management feature auto-calculates lot size based on account balance, aiding risk control
Clean code structure with separated indicator calls and signal logic for easy understanding and modification
Trailing stop support helps lock in floating profits during trending markets
cons: 缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能导致入场滑点和止损被轻易触发
没有新K线检查机制，同一根K线上可能重复开仓导致仓位失控
固定止盈止损不适应不同市场波动率，在低波动期止损可能过大而在高波动期止盈可能过小
缺少交易时段过滤，可能在流动性差的时段产生不良交易
没有回撤控制或最大亏损限制，在连续亏损时缺乏保护机制
cons_en: No spread filter mechanism — high spreads can cause entry slippage and easy stop-loss triggering
Lacks new bar check — may repeatedly open positions on the same bar causing position overloading
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss do not adapt to varying market volatility — SL may be too large in low volatility while TP may be too small in high volatility
Missing trading session filter — may generate poor trades during low-liquidity periods
No drawdown control or maximum loss limit — lacks protection during consecutive losing streaks
improvements: 增加新K线检查逻辑，确保每根K线只开一次仓，防止重复信号导致仓位叠加
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整，替代固定点数设置
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
增加最大回撤限制和最大连续亏损次数限制，提升资金安全性
improvements_en: Add new bar check logic to ensure only one trade per bar, preventing position stacking from repeated signals
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapts to market volatility instead of fixed pip values
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Implement maximum drawdown limit and maximum consecutive loss count limit for enhanced capital safety

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致仓位过度集中
固定止盈止损无法适应市场波动率变化，可能造成不必要的亏损或过早止盈
没有最大回撤保护机制，连续亏损时缺乏安全阀
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损容易被打穿
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check — may repeatedly open positions on the same bar causing excessive position concentration
Fixed TP/SL cannot adapt to market volatility changes, potentially causing unnecessary losses or premature profit-taking
No maximum drawdown protection mechanism — lacks a safety valve during consecutive losses
Missing spread filter — stop-losses can easily be triggered in high-spread environments
